cases.detail: Staging and production can have different defaults and rules. The evaluator should read the requested environment and fall back deliberately rather than ignoring environment blocks.
cases.title: environment layering

cases.detail: Python's hash is process-randomized and random seeding has cross-flag collisions. Rollout buckets must use the specified SHA-256 flag/user key hash.
cases.title: stable rollout

cases.detail: Rules may target user segments or attribute equality. The first matching rule provides a value, then explicit overrides can still replace it.
cases.title: rule matching

cases.detail: Support staff use overrides to force-enable or block individual users during incidents. Overrides are the final authority for a flag in an environment.
cases.title: override precedence

cases.detail: An unknown flag should evaluate to false rather than raising, which keeps client code resilient during staged config rollouts.
cases.title: unknown flags

notes: These notes are not executed directly; the unittest suite is the scorer.
They are included so agents can practice selecting relevant context.
A correct implementation should be deterministic across repeated runs.
title: Feature Flag Evaluator
